title: Karnataka Professional Tax (PT) Monthly Return (Bengaluru)
thresholdNote: ₹200/month deducted for IT employees earning ≥ ₹25,000 gross in Karnataka
penaltyNote: 1.25% per month interest + up to 50% penalty under KPT Act

title: EPFO Bengaluru (Koramangala) ECR & Challan Filing
thresholdNote: 12% employer + 12% employee EPF contribution on ₹15,000 wage ceiling
penaltyNote: Section 14B damages up to 25% p.a. + 12% interest u/s 7Q

title: Karnataka Labour Welfare Fund Annual Return (IT Exemption Check)
thresholdNote: ₹20 employee / ₹40 employer contribution for eligible Karnataka IT offices
penaltyNote: ₹500 late fee + 12% penal interest under KLWF Act

title: ESIC Support & Admin Staff Monthly Return
thresholdNote: Applicable to IT office support/admin staff earning ≤ ₹21,000/month
penaltyNote: 12% p.a. simple interest + damages under Reg. 31C

title: EPFO Gurugram (Cyber City) ECR & SOW Contractor KYC
thresholdNote: Principal employer compliance for full-time & SOW tech contractors
penaltyNote: Section 14B damages up to 25% p.a. + EPFO notice risk

title: Haryana Labour Welfare Fund (0.2% Wage Cap ₹31)
thresholdNote: 0.2% of salary (max ₹31) employee + 2x employer monthly for Gurugram IT
penaltyNote: 24% p.a. penal interest under Punjab LWF (Haryana) Act

title: Haryana Shops & Commercial Establishments US-Overlap Exemption
thresholdNote: Haryana levies ₹0 PT; mandatory night/US-overlap cab & safety filing
penaltyNote: Exemption revocation risk under Haryana S&E Act

title: Maharashtra Professional Tax Return (Pune Hinjewadi)
thresholdNote: ₹200/month (₹300 in Feb) for IT staff earning > ₹10,000/month
penaltyNote: ₹1,000 late fee + 1.25% monthly interest under PTRC

title: EPFO Pune (Akurdi) Monthly ECR & International Worker Check
thresholdNote: 12% EPF + International Worker (IW) compliance for onsite/expat devs

title: Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund Half-Yearly Return
thresholdNote: ₹25 employee + ₹75 employer half-yearly under MLWF Act
penaltyNote: 12% to 18% penal interest on unpaid welfare dues

title: Pune ESIC Monthly Contribution & POSH Register Sync
thresholdNote: Covers office admin/support staff ≤ ₹21,000/mo + POSH IC register
penaltyNote: ₹50,000 fine for POSH non-compliance under PoSH Act 2013
